system.description: Armor Class: 7 Hit Dice: 3 (M) Move: 9' (3') Attacks: See below Damage: Nil No. Appearing: 1d8 (0) Save As: F2 Morale: 12 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 0 Alignment: Neutral XP Value: 35 Monster Type: Lowlife (Common). Shriekers look like giant mushrooms. They live in underground caverns and are able to move around slowly. They react to light (within 60') and movement (within 30') by emitting a piercing shriek which lasts for ld3 rounds.
